render_neural_volume: render an object from training or novel camera viewpoints using a trained neural volume autoencoder
import_module_dynamic: dynamically import a Python module from a file path using importlib and register it in sys.modules
run_render_cli: run the render CLI with an experiment config file path and profile name to generate rendered outputs
load_autoencoder_params: load trained autoencoder parameters from aeparams.pt and apply them to the model with partial state matching
review_render_pipeline: review the render pipeline that loads datasets, runs the autoencoder forward pass, and writes batch outputs
